"""Gradient-flow and numerical derivative tests for the c117 hyperbolic RQ-VAE."""
import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace

import torch

ROOT = Path.cwd() / "stage2_RQ-VAE" / "TIGER_c117_hyperbolic_item_semantic_id"
if not ROOT.is_dir():
    ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[5] / "stage2_RQ-VAE" / "TIGER_c117_hyperbolic_item_semantic_id"
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
from model.hyperbolic import exp_0, log_0, hyperbolic_distance
from model.model import RQVAE


class HyperbolicGradientTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_exp_log_roundtrip_gradcheck_and_finite_difference(self):
        # Deliberately nonzero, interior vectors avoid the removable zero/boundary
        # singularities and make numerical derivatives informative.
        v = torch.tensor([[0.13, -0.21, 0.08]], dtype=torch.double, requires_grad=True)
        self.assertTrue(torch.autograd.gradcheck(exp_0, (v,), eps=1e-6, atol=2e-5, rtol=2e-4))
        x = exp_0(v)
        recovered = log_0(x)
        self.assertTrue(torch.allclose(recovered, v, atol=1e-10, rtol=1e-9))
        grad, = torch.autograd.grad(recovered.square().sum(), v)
        self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(grad).all())
        self.assertGreater(grad.norm().item(), 1e-4)
        # Explicit central finite difference of a scalar through both maps.
        with torch.no_grad():
            eps = 1e-6
            plus, minus = v.detach().clone(), v.detach().clone()
            plus[0, 1] += eps
            minus[0, 1] -= eps
            fd = (log_0(exp_0(plus)).square().sum() - log_0(exp_0(minus)).square().sum()) / (2 * eps)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(grad[0, 1].item(), fd.item(), delta=2e-6)

    def test_distance_gradcheck_and_nonzero_pair_gradients(self):
        x = torch.tensor([[0.12, -0.07]], dtype=torch.double, requires_grad=True)
        y = torch.tensor([[0.31, 0.16]], dtype=torch.double, requires_grad=True)
        f = lambda a, b: hyperbolic_distance(exp_0(a), exp_0(b)).sum()
        self.assertTrue(torch.autograd.gradcheck(f, (x, y), eps=1e-6, atol=3e-5, rtol=3e-4))
        loss = f(x, y).square()
        gx, gy = torch.autograd.grad(loss, (x, y))
        self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(gx).all() and torch.isfinite(gy).all())
        self.assertGreater(gx.norm().item(), 1e-5)
        self.assertGreater(gy.norm().item(), 1e-5)

    def test_real_three_level_rqvae_backward_reaches_encoder_and_each_codebook(self):
        torch.manual_seed(17)
        cfg = SimpleNamespace(hidden_sizes=(7,), codebook_dim=3, dropout=0.0,
            geometry="hyperbolic", codebook_num=3, codebook_size=(4, 4, 4),
            vq_type="vq", beta=0.25, sk_epsilon=-1.0, sk_iters=-1)
        model = RQVAE(cfg, in_dim=5)
        # Non-symmetric, separated values prevent degenerate equal-distance assignments.
        with torch.no_grad():
            for level, layer in enumerate(model.rq.vq_layers):
                layer.embed.weight.copy_(torch.randn(4, 3) * 0.12 + level * 0.035)
        batch = torch.tensor([[0.4, -0.3, 0.2, 0.7, -0.1],
                              [-0.6, 0.5, 0.8, -0.2, 0.3],
                              [0.1, 0.9, -0.5, 0.2, 0.6],
                              [0.8, 0.1, 0.3, -0.7, -0.4]], dtype=torch.float32)
        reconstruction, quant_loss, _, tokens = model(batch)
        self.assertEqual(tuple(tokens.shape), (4, 3))
        loss, _ = model.compute_loss(batch, reconstruction, quant_loss)
        self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(loss))
        loss.backward()
        encoder_grads = [p.grad for p in model.encoder.parameters() if p.requires_grad]
        self.assertTrue(encoder_grads and all(g is not None and torch.isfinite(g).all() for g in encoder_grads))
        self.assertGreater(sum(g.norm().item() for g in encoder_grads), 1e-7)
        for i, layer in enumerate(model.rq.vq_layers):
            grad = layer.embed.weight.grad
            self.assertIsNotNone(grad, f"level {i} codebook disconnected")
            self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(grad).all(), f"level {i} codebook has nonfinite gradient")
            self.assertGreater(grad.norm().item(), 1e-8, f"level {i} codebook gradient is zero")

    def test_negative_controls_detect_disconnection_and_nan(self):
        p = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.tensor([2.0]))
        detached = (p * 3).detach().sum()
        self.assertFalse(detached.requires_grad)
        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
            detached.backward()
        q = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.tensor([1.0]))
        disconnected = (q * 0).sum()  # connected but zero derivative is also caught
        disconnected.backward()
        self.assertIsNotNone(q.grad)
        self.assertEqual(q.grad.abs().sum().item(), 0.0)
        nan_loss = (q * torch.tensor(float("nan"))).sum()
        self.assertFalse(torch.isfinite(nan_loss).item())
        nan_loss.backward()
        self.assertFalse(torch.isfinite(q.grad).all().item())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
